source_summary: Supplied evidence records a single-source use: a water skin or leather water container whose parts are sewn to one another. The relevant feature is the stitched-together construction, not merely being a container.

neighbor_coverage.note: Deri su kabi, tulum dikisi ve kap yapisi adaylari incelendi; en acik sinir dikilerek birlestirilme ozelligidir.
